overview: Research draft record, unpublished: every statement below is an unverified lead, not a verified fact. A medical and pharmaceutical university based in Zaporizhzhia, south-eastern Ukraine, with an international section for foreign students. This draft is gated on teaching location: the university's own undated pages say foreign students are taught in Berehove, Zakarpattia, and no part of this record may be published until a dated official statement says where and how foreign students are taught in the current academic year. Draft record built from search-snippet leads on 2026-10-11; every field below is awaiting verification against the official pages listed under research references and nothing here is presented as a current fact.

openQuestions: TEACHING LOCATION AND OPERATING CONDITIONS (gate — answer first): a dated official statement for 2026–27 on where and how foreign students are taught (Berehove, Zaporizhzhia or remotely), which programmes and years the Berehove arrangement covers, and whether it is current. The Berehove pages found are undated. No other work on this record should be published until this is answered.
Which academic year the requirements page and the tuition page currently state (snippets conflict: 2024 table dates, 2025-2026 titles, 2026-2027 content reported).
Official postal address(es) and international-office contacts as printed.

Language of instruction for foreign applicants per programme (Medicine: a Ukrainian-medium row in the admissions table and English-medium listed elsewhere; Dentistry, Pharmacy, Pediatrics and Perfume-Cosmetic Technology: not stated on the official domain).
Level, specialty code and exact award title for each programme.
Official tuition fees with the academic year and payment schedule (official page and Ministry portal; year labels conflict).
Intake windows and dates for the current cycle (only "no later than November 1 and March 1" and 2024 table dates found).
Entrance examinations: subjects and format for the current cycle (pass mark 6 out of 12 seen).
Required documents for foreign applicants (none in the snippets).
Preparatory faculty: duration, subjects, language of instruction on an official page, certificate, progression wording verbatim, fee with year, start date, and whether it runs in Berehove.

Therapy and Rehabilitation (227), nursing (a third-party directory lists "Nursing (Cosmetology)") and public health: whether any is offered and open to foreign applicants, at what level and in which language.
